title_en: Last Night I Went, Dear Mother
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'на бостано' and 'ѓердано', 'фустано' carry a dialect definite or vocative ending -о; I read them as plain nouns. 'пустото ми лудо ... мирно не остана' is my reading: 'the wretched lad would not stay still'.

words_to_learn.en: evening gathering for spinning and socializing

lines.cyr: Сношти појдов, мила мамо, на седенка
lines.lat: Snošti pojdov, mila mamo, na sedenka
lines.en: Last night I went, dear mother, to the spinning party

lines.cyr: и некој ме фати, мамо, за плетенка.
lines.lat: i nekoj me fati, mamo, za pletenka.
lines.en: and someone grabbed me, mother, by the braid.

lines.cyr: Тој држ - јас држ, тој трга - јас тргам,
lines.lat: Toj drž - jas drž, toj trga - jas trgam,
lines.en: He holds - I hold, he pulls - I pull,

lines.cyr: тој трга - јас тргам, тој натамо - јас навамо,
lines.lat: toj trga - jas trgam, toj natamo - jas navamo,
lines.en: he pulls - I pull, he that way - I this way,

lines.cyr: се скина плетенка, мамо, се скина плетенка,
lines.lat: se skina pletenka, mamo, se skina pletenka,
lines.en: the braid tore off, mother, the braid tore off,

lines.cyr: пустото ми лудо, мамо, мирно не остана.
lines.lat: pustoto mi ludo, mamo, mirno ne ostana.
lines.en: the wretched lad, mother, did not stay quiet.

lines.cyr: Па си појдов, мила мамо, на орото,
lines.lat: Pa si pojdov, mila mamo, na oroto,
lines.en: Then I went, dear mother, to the round dance,
